summary: Resumed review on 31 October 2026: both WhatsApp groups were reviewed for the authorized 22–31 October window. The main group has 62 message units and the CA group has 13; all seven images and five PDFs (nine pages) were audited. Main-group coverage ends at 11:10:00 IST and CA coverage at 11:10:10 IST. The earlier CA sweep checkpoint at 11:04 IST remains preserved in the dated clarification. No 31 October post was rendered through those cutoffs; this is partial run-day coverage, not whole-day completeness. Original message UI timestamps remain timezone-unverified. The resumed official pass attempted five exact CNR targets: four full dockets and one blocked retrieval. Morning checks remain separately dated. Across both same-day batches, 13 attempts cover 12 distinct retained CNR references, with 11 distinct official dockets retrieved and two blocked attempts. These are not 11 confirmed firm-profile matches. Separately coordinated research retrieved DVC 54/2026 at 11:31:30 IST; Section 31 SR 2229 remains office-reported and file 260 stays separate. A separate MC 121/2023 portal route failed before a case query and is not counted as a freshly queried CNR. Including that independently retrieved docket, 13 distinct retained CNRs were queried and 12 official dockets were retrieved across the same-day work. Of 220 retained references, 207 were not freshly queried; this denominator includes historical, gated and stopped scopes, not 220 eligible active cases. No case-profile reclassification or automatic resumption of stopped proceedings is inferred.
